from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIntangibleAsset(BaseModel):
    """One company's intangible asset value from their financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name, e.g. '广东银禧科技股份有限公司'")
    intangible_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The intangible assets amount as reported in the balance sheet, in yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt anchoring the value extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_intangible_assets: list[CompanyIntangibleAsset]
